# Reza Shahnazar | رضا شاه‌نظر

> Personal website: https://www.shahnazar.me/

## Identity

- Canonical name (English): Reza Shahnazar
- Canonical name (Persian/Farsi): رضا شاه‌نظر
- Full legal name: Reza Shahnazar Nezhad Khalesi (رضا شاه نظر نژاد خالصی)
- Born: October 30, 1991 (8 Aban 1370 in Persian calendar)
- Location: Tehran, Iran

## Summary

Reza Shahnazar is a board-certified cardiologist (MD) and software engineer with 17+ years of professional experience spanning medicine and technology. He is focused on building data-driven and AI-enabled solutions for healthcare and large-scale digital platforms. Gold medalist of the Iran National Biology Olympiad.

## Current Position

Software Engineer at Digikala (Iran's largest e-commerce platform), working in the Shopping team within the Technology division. Previously held roles as Product Marketing Manager, Data Science Lead, and Senior Data Scientist at the same company.

## Education

1. Cardiology Fellowship (Board Certified)
   - Tehran University of Medical Sciences, Tehran Heart Center
   - 2018-2022 (1397-1401 in Persian calendar)
   - Specialization: Cardiovascular Medicine, Clinical Research

2. Doctor of Medicine (MD)
   - Tehran University of Medical Sciences
   - 2009-2016 (1388-1395 in Persian calendar)

3. Gold Medal - Iran National Biology Olympiad
   - Young Scholars Club (باشگاه دانش‌پژوهان جوان)
   - 2008 (1387 in Persian calendar)
